system.description:
You drive your deception straight into a single victim's mind, and for him the illusion becomes absolute: phantom fire truly burns, a phantom wall truly bars the way, an illusory stake through the heart truly paralyzes.

Expend one Willpower Trait and defeat your victim in a Social Challenge (retest Subterfuge); the power affects only that one target. The nightmarish creation lasts the entire scene and, being wholly under your control, needs no further tests — a chimerical gun that always hits, a stake that seems to bend unerringly toward the heart. Wounds it inflicts last until the victim is convinced either that the effect was illusory or that he has been "healed." Such illusory injury can drive the victim into a comatose state but cannot kill.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
